newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish forces kill more than 40 Kurd rebels.
newsitem.headline: Turkish forces kill more than 40 Kurd rebels.

text.p: Security forces have killed 41 Kurdish separatist guerillas in recent clashes, authorities in eastern Turkey said on Thursday.

A statement from the office of the governor responsible for emergency law in 10 eastern provinces said 32 members of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) were killed in Van, Hakkari, Sirnak and Diyarbakir in the last two days.

A separate statement from the governor of Erzurum province, which is not under emergency rule, said nine PKK fighters were killed in operations during the last four days along the border between the eastern provinces of Bingol and Erzurum.
Neither statement made any mention of casualties among government troops in the clashes.
More than 20,000 people have been killed in a 12-year armed conflict between government forces and PKK guerrillas, fighting for self-rule in eastern Turkey.
